name: Genetic privacy
description: Rules concerning the collection, use, disclosure, retention, or protection of genetic information.

name: Genetic discrimination
description: Rules concerning decisions or unequal treatment based on genetic information or genetic-test results.

name: Employment
description: Rules concerning how employers and other employment entities may obtain or use genetic information.

name: Health insurance
description: Rules concerning genetic information in health-plan eligibility, coverage, underwriting, or reimbursement.

name: Life insurance
description: Rules concerning how life insurers may request or use genetic information.

name: Disability insurance
description: Rules concerning how disability insurers may request or use genetic information.

name: Long-term care insurance
description: Rules concerning how long-term care insurers may request or use genetic information.

name: Direct-to-consumer genetic testing
description: Rules concerning genetic testing services marketed or provided directly to consumers.

name: Research
description: Rules and policies concerning genetic information or biological samples used in research.

name: Biobanks
description: Rules concerning repositories that collect, store, manage, or distribute biological samples and related data.

name: Consent
description: Requirements for permission or informed consent before specified genetic tests, collections, or uses.

name: Data sharing
description: Rules concerning disclosure, transfer, or access to genetic information between people or organizations.

name: Data sale
description: Rules concerning the sale of genetic information or its transfer in exchange for value.

name: Data deletion
description: Rights or duties concerning deletion of genetic information held by an organization.

name: Sample destruction
description: Rights or duties concerning destruction of biological samples after collection or testing.

name: Law enforcement
description: Rules concerning law-enforcement access to or use of genetic information and DNA samples.

name: Forensic investigative genetic genealogy
description: Rules concerning the use of genetic genealogy databases and family relationships in investigations.

name: Newborn screening
description: Rules and policies concerning genetic or related screening of newborns and retained screening specimens.

name: Reproductive genetics
description: Rules concerning genetic testing or information in reproductive and prenatal settings.

name: Minors
description: Rules concerning genetic testing, information, consent, or decision-making involving minors.

name: AI and genomics
description: Rules and policies concerning artificial intelligence used with genomic information or genetic analyses.
